newsitem.title: BELGIUM: OLOs firm, spread down on German benchmark change.
newsitem.headline: OLOs firm, spread down on German benchmark change.

text.p: Belgian linear bonds started higher on Friday, awaiting U.S. jobs data at 1230 GMT in thin holiday trade.
The market was closed for Labour Day on Thursday and many traders had taken Friday off as well.
U.S. April payrolls are seen at 211,000, from 175,000. The unemployment rate is seen unchanged at 5.2 percent.

The March 2007 OLO's yield eased to 5.88 percent, from 5.93 pct on Wednesday, nine basis points over equivalent Bunds, from 14. Dealers said this was because the German 10-year benchmark was changed from the January 2007 to the July 2007 Bund.
